image.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first).

prompt.note: One pose per line; each line becomes one image (max_rows widget 4 = 51). Widgets 0 and 2 are prefix/suffix strings, widget 3 start_index.

images.note: One file per prompt line. SaveImage 35 is the bypassed detail pass.

notes: No batch count: the number of images equals the number of lines in the prompt list.
